data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a gross release of technical reserves of GBP 8.7m in respect of prior periods in 2015 (2014: GBP 9.5m). The improvement was described as arising predominantly from fire and other damage to property. The opening gross claims outstanding (31 Dec 2014) was GBP 35.195m. The prior-year release (~GBP 8.7m) therefore represents approximately a 24.7% reduction versus opening gross claims. Named individual losses referenced in the report include a settled medical isotope plant claim and a fuel fabrication plant claim (both relating to earlier years) and two 2015 non-power claims (fire in France and dust contamination in the Netherlands) with combined reserves of GBP 2.4m.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet comparative column (31 Dec 2014) - explicit. Prior year development comes from the Movement in prior year's provision narrative ('released GBP 8.7m') - the note is explicit and treated as gross. Claims development triangle exists in the notes but is presented as net; no clear, separate gross movement table was found, so the gross prior-year movement is taken from the explicit narrative. Some descriptive event amounts are reported as paid or reserved in the text; their mapping to reserve movement is not always explicit, so event amounts are recorded in named events where quantifed by the report but are not re-attributed to the prior-year movement total.
